name: Bay Area Speedcubin' 14 2019
information: This competition will be held by Berkeley Cube Club, in place of the normally scheduled Berkeley Winter 2019 competition. **Competition Day Timing** * The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. * Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. * Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. For further information, please refer to the "[Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BayAreaSpeedcubin152019#8338-information)" tab.
